notes.title: 🐤Roadmap🐢
notes.content:
[p]Hey friends, hope you're all doing well!:)🧡[/p][p][/p][p]Paper Animal Adventure launched almost exactly 2 weeks ago into Early Access on Steam, and I have been blown away by how much you all like the game!!:D [/p][p][b]We're currently sitting at 89 reviews[/b] (with 88 of them positive😱), which is so close to 100! Reaching 100 reviews would be another milestone, where the Steam algorithm would help show the game to even more people💪[/p][p][/p][p]Since the game is in Early Access you're probably wondering which updates are planned leading up to the full V1.0. I've already talked about two of them, namely the Plus Update and the Rewind Update. [/p][p]You can still vote which one of those two you want to see first! Currently the Plus Update is leading by quite a bit. Instructions about how to vote can be found here:[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1982120/view/658207707628568848"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]The Early Access version will receive 4 bigger updates and with the 4th and last one we're also transitioning into the full game! Alright, let's jump into the content that will be added:[/p][p][/p][h1][b]Plus Update[/b][/h1][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42505570/6515289c50a6d0ed512b28e277ef84e02f14b2c4.png"][/img][/p][p]More, more, more! Can’t get enough of Paper Animal Adventure? The Plus Update packs in a mountain of new content to discover, collect, and master![/p][list][*][p]​[b]​2 new Enemies per area​[/b]​ – that’s 16 unique foes to challenge your skills![/p][/*][*][p]​[b]​​3 new Characters​[/b]​ to join your adventure![/p][/*][*][p]​[b]​15 new Items​[/b]​ – lots of new cooking recipes![/p][/*][*][p]​[b]​5 new Skills and 15 new Attributes​[/b]​ to supercharge your team![/p][/*][*][p][b]​20 new Stickers​[/b]​ to make your runs even crazier![/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h1][b]Rewind Update​[/b][/h1][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42505570/6c057e8422fb6d41527d2c22e921e79473054dad.png"][/img][/p][p]Ever wondered what‘s in the west part of the Gear Shrine? You can find out yourself after rescuing Sir Bearington now with the Rewind Update! Use the Rewind Clock to start a Rewind Run, where you’ll keep your current heroes, stats and inventory and dive back into an alternative reality, where you can experience the second half of the story!​[/p][list][*][p][b]An alternate version of each of the 8 areas​[/b]​, featuring tougher enemy variants, alternate aesthetics, new music and more powerful bosses![/p][/*][*][p][b]Uncover the fate of Kael and Lillith​[/b]​, and discover how you and Sir Bearington are entangled in this story![/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h1][b]Camps & Challenges[/b]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42505570/7d643a670ec8534b63ffb366394febdc16164f4d.png"][/img][/h1][p]Are you more of a cozy gamer or someone who is looking for a real challenge? In this update there's a new content for both! [/p][list][*][p][b]2 new Characters [/b]- meet some new faces with unique abilities![/p][/*][*][p][b]C-Skins[/b] so that every characters gets another alternate look![/p][/*][*][p][b]Tournament Mode[/b] where you can compete with other players on a shared seed and climb the global leaderboard![/p][/*][*][p][b]Challenges Mode[/b] where you can experience the game with 25 unique challenges, each with special gameplay twists and modifiers![/p][/*][*][p][b]New Traders[/b] - fully embrace capitalism with some shady (but helpful) merchants![/p][/*][*][p][b]New Fanmails [/b]for a bit more variety with side-quests![/p][/*][*][p][b]New Camp Customization stuff [/b]- make your camp even more personal and share it with others![/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h1][b]Chaos & Coop[/b][/h1][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42505570/6f923e48942d512ae05e95da9225b31b0edd76d3.png"][/img][/p][p]Rewinding time might not be enough to uncover the true source of this world’s evil... Grab a friend for local/couch co-op and dive deeper into the [b]Chaos Realm[/b]![/p][list][*][p][b]Local/Couch Co-Op mode [/b]- experience the game with a friend!:)[/p][/*][*][p][b]Chaos Realm [/b]- a new endless mode, where the game gets harder and harder the deeper you go![/p][/*][*][p][b]3 new Characters [/b]- more heroes, more playstyles, more fun![/p][/*][*][p][b]Chroma Skins [/b]to show off your characters have reached Level 10![/p][/*][*][p][b]Evolved Passives [/b]to become strong enough to survive in the Chaos Realm![/p][/*][*][p][b]New Items, Skills and Stickers [/b]- because let's be honest... there’s never too much content xd[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h1][b]Thanks for reading🧡[/b][/h1][p align="start"]Thanks for reading so far, that's it for today friends!!:)[/p][p]I hope I can share more info soon about the time-frames in which these updates will be released, but I'm already super excited to hear what you all think about them![/p][p align="start"]Take care of yourself and others!:D🧡[/p]

notes.title: What will be in the Early Access version?
notes.content:
[p]Hey friends, hope you're all doing well!:)🧡[/p][p]The release of Paper Animal Adventure on 7th August is just under two weeks away and I'm insanely excited!! Since there was some confusion I do want to mention that the release in two weeks is an [b]Early Access version that will only release on Steam (PC)! [/b][/p][p]This means that the release on other plattforms, including console releases, will still take a bit of time :( But I'm trying my very best to get quickly to the V1.0 that will release on all major plattforms and consoles. [/p][p]Since I spent most of this month with preparing a trailer, coordinating stuff and reaching out to content creators I figured it would be a good opportunity today to talk about what's actually gonna be in the Early Acess version. There's a bunch of more content already available, but much of it is not polished / balanced, so much of it will be added over the course of the Early Access phase :)[/p][p]Let's jump into it💪[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h1][b]Characters🐣[/b][/h1][p][/p][p]There will be a total of 10 characters available in the Early Access version!:)[/p][p]You'll start with [b]Peep, Shelp and Kwak[/b] and later you can unlock [b]Cookie, Indie and Nana[/b].[/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42505570/dae3315f2b03c32a961c3dc2f92f6cc8e8082309.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Over the course of your adventure you can get a variety of eggs: a dino egg, an axolotl egg and a pig egg. When you feed the eggs in your camp a character will hatch that will join your team! This means the [b]Dino, Axolotl and Pig[/b] are also available characters:)[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42505570/0ee62de5dd63b95202ad92bddeeae9746067022d.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]The Dino and Axolotl have five different variants, each with their own stats and roles. The Pig has four different ones💪[/p][p]The last available character can also be gotten in a run, but only if you chose to go to the Kaboom Dunes route. Can you guess which character I'm talking about?[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42505570/c6b99542753b8627f6d60a0e43146f64e8e3149a.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]The [b]Crewmate[/b]![/p][p]So this makes a total of 10 available characters! You can start your adventure with 6 of them and can find 4 of them in your runs:)[/p][p]Furthermore every character has their standard A-Skin and you can also unlock their B-Skin.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42505570/1ee7723d6453b7482873cc7b471da9868102ea86.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Other skins will be made available in later versions💪[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h1][b]Areas🗺️[/b][/h1][p][/p][p]Early Access has a bit of a bad reputation, because many players (often rightfully) say the game provided is more an alpha/beta and is very incomplete.[/p][p]I didn't want to convey the feeling of the game being super incomplete, so I decided to include[b] all 8 base areas![/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42505570/862078d8ff77826337c7674f4a38588607fdb88b.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]This also means you can fully complete the base game!✨[/b][/p][p]There's no Rewind and Chaos areas yet, those will also become available with later updates:)[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h1][b]Items, Skills and Stickers🍎[/b][/h1][p][/p][p]The Early Access version will start with a pool of 30 available Items!:) These include all base Items you can pickup anywhere (e.g. Fern, Honey, Cherrock) and a few general base Items (e.g. Tomapple, Golden Potion, Protein Powder).[/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42505570/20f734ab242558085e365acd9f1c724e5b6d68a1.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]The Cookpot will also be available, but not the Super Cookpot yet. The range of recipes is rather small, but will expanded later on too! For now you can cook Cake, Sweet Candy, Sour Candy, Spicy Candy, Spooky Candy and Salad💪[/p][p]Skill-wise we will start with a range of 10 available ones![/p][list][*][p][b]Brawler Skills[/b]: Aerial Impulse, Thorntendril, Pyroblast[/p][/*][*][p][b]Caster Skills[/b]: Bubblegun, Windblade, BojoBoom[/p][/*][*][p][b]Utility Skills[/b]: Guardian Sphere, Domain, ZzZFuel, Second Tackle[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42505570/21466236b596f6deaf0a8b3f5946a894b543466b.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]There will also be 35 attributes out of 51 available (so a lot!).[/p][p]Also the game will launch with 30 Stickers. Currently there are about 85 programmed, but the rest of them (and hopefully some more) will also be added via later updates:)[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42505570/829080a584a3b68900ee10fd670a9cdc31629c22.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p](Please ignore the pyramid there xd)[/p][p]These will be the 6 Everyone is X stickers based on the available characters in the Character Select Screen, as well as some more basic ones like [b]Berserk, Boon, Twin Trouble, SPEEDCAT or Third Gear.[/b][/p][p]The Holo and Cursed system will also be included right from the start![/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h1][b]Other stuff🐛[/b][/h1][p][/p][p][b]Difficulty Settings[/b] will also be available! With the absence of Rewind Runs I thought the Very Hard and Nightmare difficulties would be needed to offer you guys a challenge:)[/p][p]I also want to mention that the Nightmare difficulty isn't available from the start on, but it will be unlocked as soon as you beat the base game:)[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42505570/4bb27b806c876a95242fa6fe25f0907388f754df.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]The game's achievements system has space for about 220 achievements. Out of those 110, so 50%, will be available:)[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42505570/e4d95d76b36868f4c32b266cc48e7f0b38f329d0.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Cards will also be of course there! I haven't gotten too far with filling all the slots, but about 10 different packs are there💪[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42505570/b5c09820a43c638f9c8ed38ad6306f40afa5eb33.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Also Camp Building and Traders will be available normally. I'm not sure yet if you're able to upload your camp and find others in the first Early Access version, but it definitely will be added at some point![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42505570/44ca542a8459124b7892d64f02d72ff16d93bca3.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h1][b]What will be added over the course of the Early Access phase✨[/b][/h1][p][/p][p]Content that will be added over the course of the Early Access phase and leading up to the V1.0 includes but is not limited to:[/p][list][*][p][b]Online Tournaments:[/b] With global Score and Time Attack leaderboards[/p][/*][*][p][b]Challenges:[/b] Probably around 52, but I'm thinking about reducing them, since 52 is a lot and might feel like a bit much lol[/p][/*][*][p][b]Proviant Packs: [/b]Daily changing starting objects that you can take with you on your run[/p][/*][*][p][b]Rewind & Chaos runs:[/b] Basically New Game+ and New Game++ modes[/p][/*][*][p][b]Super Cookpot[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Crystal Forge[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]More characters (and skins), Items, Skills and Stickers, etc.[/b][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h1][b]Thanks for reading🧡[/b][/h1][p][/p][p]That's it for today friends, thanks for reading so far!![/p][p]I'm insanely excited (but also pretty anxious) about the launch in 13 days! Please consider telling your peers also about the game, the more people are interested in Paper Animal Adventure the stronger the launch will be!:D (And maybe I'm able to pay for my health insurance a bit longer lol)[/p][p]Take care of yourself and others and see you in a few days!!!🚀🧡[/p]

notes.title: Development Update #11
notes.content:
[p]Hey friends, hope you're all doing well!:D🧡[/p][p]First of all I wanted to say thank you again for all the supportive and kind comments you guys left when I announced that the release will be postponed - thank you all so much, this means a lot🙏 I'm still insanely excited for the game to release and I'm also super much looking forward to what you guys will think about it!![/p][p]Otherwise there's not too much going on right now - summer has arrived in full force, so I'm constantly sweating and it's way too hot lol. The worst thing for me is when the nights aren't cold enough anymore to balance out the heat from the day, so everything just gradually gets hotter and hotter😂[/p][p]Anyway, it's the last Friday of the month, so here comes the content update for June 2025 as promised💪
[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h1]Flashbacks[b]🎥[/b][/h1][p][/p][p]The game still needed a bit more of story / lore and while I had planned it already out some time ago, it still wasn't really in the game.[/p][p]When you collect a Magical Gear piece now and enter the Portal afterwards, a short "flashback" scene will play.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42505570/aabd9d584eb29c5e31a216280facf27857025472.png"][/img][/p][p]There are currently 8 different flashbacks scenes that kinda narrate how everything happened and led up to the current situation and also introduces and explores a bunch of new (and old) important characters:D[/p][p]I really don't want to spoil too much here - just wanted to mention that I've added them😊[/p][p]I also want to add 8 more in the future for the Rewind Runs💪[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h1][b]Rewind Mystery Houses❓[/b][/h1][p][/p][p]Rewind Runs make everything harder and I wanted to expand that onto Mystery Houses too, so now we have Rewind Mystery Houses:D Each Mystery House now has an additional twist, that makes them a little bit harder than their normal counterpart![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42505570/27abd21ad213fcb74f85de9adc76fe7f5afb5d57.png"][/img][/p][p]Blue Mystery houses in normal runs have either a green tile or a red tile. In the Rewind Run version it has [b]a green, a yellow and a red tile[/b] - but you still need to have all tiles green to complete it😱[/p][p]If you walk through every tile perfectly you won't notice any difference, because red still turns green first, but if you walk on a green tile again it will first turn yellow, then red and then green again😅[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42505570/f3f8015d0c21d9b887b1de29600e6ac9b01d6d72.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]The Yellow Mystery House will have a [b]permanent darkness mask![/b] This means you won't be able to find the right way to the flag as easily.[/p][p]The Pink and Green Mystery Houses are also different, but you have to find that out for yourself✨[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h1][b]Twitch Integration🟪[/b][/h1][p][/p][p]To make Paper Animal Adventure more interesting for content creators (and more fun in general lol) I decided to [b]a small Twitch integration![/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42505570/feae424b80e4d79569f2883a1b2f6d75d5fec436.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]You can hook up the game to your Twitch chat and then [b]your viewers and their names will get synced to the game.[/b] They behave like the normal audience, but I felt like it would be cool if you could see yourself as a chatter in the stream haha[/p][p]But that's not all![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42505570/fa7301fe022f295937394382fa40066ffcbedb8e.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]Chatters can also use different commands to interact with the game.[/b] If they type "!pyroblast" for example, a Pyroblast projectile will spawn in the game (so better be nice to your viewers xd).[/p][p]There are a total of 10 commands available:[/p][list][*][p]!heal[/p][/*][*][p]!damage[/p][/*][*][p]!cheer[/p][/*][*][p]!fart[/p][/*][*][p]!pyroblast[/p][/*][*][p]!buddybot[/p][/*][*][p]!teleport[/p][/*][*][p]!enemy[/p][/*][*][p]!buff[/p][/*][*][p]!debuff[/p][/*][/list][p]As a Twitch streamer you can also adjust the settings for them to your liking: How many actions a chatter can use per floor, how many bits do they have to send, how often a command is allowed in total per floor etc etc.[/p][p]I think this could be a lot of fun, super much looking forward to streamers experiencing this haha[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h1][b]Glossary🔍[/b][/h1][p][/p][p]The in-game Glossary also felt very incomplete, so I took some time to flesh it out more:)[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42505570/39636a7e8def4a7946f5fe4301aff11b209151b3.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]There are now [b]about 110 different texts available[/b], further explaining stuff from the game if you're curious about how something works![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42505570/d3eefebf4a8a8b629aae5d90d73044fabbe025ca.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h1][b]Outro🖌️[/b][/h1][p][/p][p]Also all the outro pieces have been finished! I don't wanna show them all off here, but I definitely have two favorites that I want to show you guys. A central topic of the story is "not all conflicts are bad, with mutual understand something better can come out of it", and two slides from the outro communicate exactly that:[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42505570/fbcc14d76081c2b61ef74ab675eb36d9e0507da1.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]This picture shows a bear and a crocodile arguing if a fan or a cap is better. The next piece is this:[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42505570/1a850ceb756a63c65bd75a3cb2efafb73c5f9443.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]Kwak shows an idea of a cap with an integrated fan![/b] I wish real life problems would be as easy to solve as this dispute lol.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h1][b]Balancing📊[/b][/h1][p][/p][p]Lots of time this months went into balancing stuff! In this case a lot of things have been made easier for the player, since the game's difficulty curve used to be quite steep (and still somewhat is😅).[/p][p]One of these things was to always add [b]a guaranteed healing tile per floor[/b] which heals 3 or 6 Health Points, and a 50% chance of adding another healing tile.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42505570/6534a9d261de7bdf972b04fc3389ee8075eb4b45.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Another small change was to remove the damage from the gas/smoke particle from enemies! [b]They now only apply debuffs. [/b][/p][p]The gas/smoke from the Tractus applies the posion debuff which effectively still deals damage (but over time), but you now won't get stopped from just turbo tackling the Tractus if you want that:D[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42505570/a56ce09b2f4cb7eab20522e44f60c7258db4a2b1.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]This also makes the Fun Ghi now the only enemy in the game which can't deal any damage to you - now I almost feel bad defeating them x)[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h1][b]Smaller Stuff⭐[/b][/h1][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42505570/fd615e02be4caf67184de8110e90ab5f72f1b8b3.png"][/img][/p][p]
With the game getting localized in a few other languages it is always difficult to find good solutions to still make all the UI elements fit well into each other. I already talked about this a few times and the solution I came up with a few weeks ago was just squish everything, but I came up with a better approach: If the text is now too big, [b]it will now scroll[/b]. Looks much better and polished in my opinion!:)[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42505570/7a02be2eba73dcfe781b43120052f1b1c8067061.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]I also took care of another thing that has been a problem for a bit: stunlocking bosses. Especially with the coop mode it was now easier than ever to just stunlock bosses indefinitely and with that just cheese the boss fight.[/p][p][b]If you attack bosses now too often they will get a stun protection![/b] They will have this rainbow effect and will still receive damage, but they won't get stunned at all. This effect wears off after about 10 seconds, but can get reactivated again if they get stunned too often![/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h1][b]Thanks for reading🧡[/b][/h1][p][/p][p]That's it for today friends, thank you for reading that far!!:)[/p][p]I'll update you guys as soon as I know more about the release date, thank you all so much again for being supportive and patient with me🙏[/p][p]Have an amazing July and take care of yourself and others:D🧡[/p]

notes.title: Development Update #10
notes.content:
Hey friends, hope you're all doing well:)🧡 

I will be out of office for the next three days, that's why this development update comes a bit early instead of this Friday! Hope you guys don't mind:D

Also before I show off the new cool content I worked on this month I wanted to say that the [b]first Early Access version won't have all the content[/b] I've talked about here - with the Early Access version you will be able to 100% complete the base game, but a bunch of content features still have to be polished and tested. They will be added over the Early Access period though, so the final game will have everything!

Also the game is still set to release into Early Access in Q2 2025, which means in the next 4/5 weeks - I'm super excited!!:D

Also while you're here: [b]If you like the game please consider sharing it with your friends and maybe on your socials - each individual wishlist helps a lot🙏[/b]

Alright friends - let's jump into the new content💪



[h1]Coop✨[/h1]

If you guys remember, we had a local Coop stretch goal back during the initial Kickstarter campaign, that we sadly didn't hit. But! I found some time this month (and I also thought having coop in the game would be super cool) and added it anyway!!:D

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42505570/49f0f38dde825dcdac71472bc56fcdc39f5db751.png[/img]

It's a [b]full coop experience[/b], meaning there's no "leading" player and the other one is just assisting/supporting. Player 1 does have the advantage that if Player 2 gets too far away, they will get sent back to Player 1.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42505570/4be8167b4e24ccf17ab98f6ed8e09ba13f648e4c.png[/img]

When you enter a battle, the [b]Gear- and Hype-units of each individual character get shown.[/b] I decided to put them left and right, instead of top and bottom for two reasons:

[list]
[*] If both of you are used to play the game in Singleplayer, everyone will look at the top ressources, because they are there in Singleplayer. This results in Player 2 often looking at the wrong ressources and then getting confused when things get heated😅
[*] If they would have been at the top and bottom the game view would have been squished even more, basically resulting in something like a 16:6 format. This way the game view is more like a 4:3-ish format. 
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42505570/37f4b35424bbd4a6979bb250d530943656b8ddde.png[/img]

When you enter a Dungeon/Boss floor from the World Map you can choose [b]who plays which character.[/b] This way you can also swap your characters if you want!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42505570/5248b2e4976da63e666e9946920918f72e50350f.png[/img]

On Camp floors you will also be both able to control your character. The UI controls are shared, which means it accepts inputs from you both, which can get a bit messy at times. But I still felt like that was the best solution🤔

If you have a good internet connection you can even play with some online friends over Steam Remote Play Together, which I think is super cool✨



[h1]Monster houses👹[/h1]

There is now a new trap type available: [b]Monster House traps![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42505570/294d0b3a97822ab9253082fb47d102cf440d65ab.png[/img]

If you step on it you'll get caged in with a bunch of enemies!😱

As soon as you defeated them all you'll be free again:D The Monster House traps also have a cool new music track for the fight😎



[h1]BuddyBots rework🤖[/h1]

I also decided to rework the [b]BuddyBot[/b] Skill a bit. The old Skill summoned BuddyBots which followed you, attacked enemies and then disappeared after some time. They were also coded as NPCs, which meant they often blocked tiles and things would get quite messy with them quickly.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42505570/0956fcde99c8ccef27b87c97a8e24b1d30fe2158.png[/img]

The new BuddyBot Skill lets you summon [b]an infinite number of them![/b] The means the bigger the floor/longer the fights the more BuddyBots you can summon🚀

They are also now flying, which means they won't block any tiles anymore.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42505570/afd4c76c7099bbf4a57ff74163470a1c5c6e42d2.png[/img]

They also have different, little faces:D With each new BuddyBot the new one will get more expensive though!



[h1]Cryo Split🍧[/h1]

I also added a new Caster Skill: [b]The Cryo Split![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42505570/7760524cd6012466ceb878e00d7bae3191943a34.png[/img]

The Cryo Split Skill shoots two snowballs in a diagonal line. This might sound easy to aim with, but I feel like it is difficult to hit enemies with it anyway haha

The projectile also pierces targets, so they won't disappear after the first hit, which is quite useful for fights with a lot of enemies💪



[h1]Thorntendril rework🪴[/h1]

The Thorntendril Skill used to summon four Thorntendrils in a diagonal pattern, but I felt like that was a bit boring.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42505570/e8fc5c1e8fc805c914de6cb6e4bc5b7a40953c98.png[/img]

The new Thorntendril Skill spawns four Thorntendrils to the top, right, left and bottom to you, which is at the base even more boring - [b]BUT[/b] - with each hit, another Thorntendril will spawn in the same direction behind the target⭐

Like in this example the Thorntendril to the right hit the Fun Ghi, so it spawned another one behind him. Again super useful for battles with a bigger group of enemies😎 It's also super satisfying if you hit a bunch of enemies with this.



[h1]New Card Packs🎴[/h1]

I also took care a bit of the Card collection menu and reworked it!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42505570/a747629213bff388a5f4e618a247a2379e054c06.png[/img]

The game will probably have a [b]total of about 35 Card collections[/b], which will make collecting them a daunting task, but I feel like more stuff to collect is more fun:D

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42505570/696077105a3ed62af101b20ad7f2dac7caeb4952.png[/img]

I also added a few new Card Packs, for example the Items Pack or the Beans and Coffees pack💪

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42505570/0c1ae503eaf4c7a83298d95a8bbd7763ec76aac9.png[/img]

But I also don't wanna spoil too much here😊



[h1]Smaller stuff⭐[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42505570/bad55fa655e5709045ca861991f7248cf5c351a7.png[/img]

When you've uploaded your Camp Map, you'll now be able to see how many players liked your Camp Map!:D

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42505570/e0ed2124dc8ed3abc87564244c800765a76391a8.png[/img]

There is now a chance for a 3D object to generate in the Shiny Caves! A huge Crystal🔮

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42505570/ba98ab171c9397a166c3eeb4b0f1c757ee5dc4fc.png[/img]

I felt like it was a bit confusing during Coop when a big menu popped up as soon as someone collected anything. Because of that there's now a setting that only shows this small indicator when you got something:D



[h1]NanaBot🟡[/h1]

I also did something wonderfully stupid this month: I added the (self-programmed) [b]NanaBot[/b] to our [url=https://discord.com/invite/EDwZ35F]Discord[/url] server! At first it had only one purpose: There's a special #nana channel in the Discord and as soon as you say anything there, all your words will get replaced by "Nana"!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42505570/202535768c48bfab998a4eac597be84ac8ea69e1.png[/img]

The Nana emote is also allowed:D

Later on I added a second function to NanaBot: Logging game events to a Discord channel, which I also think is cool✨

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42505570/dfc302bda962e3d19901a58bf8f31c11d7ed61cf.png[/img]

There probably will be an in-game setting where you can turn off sharing your activity if you don't want to!



[h1]Thanks for reading🧡[/h1]

That's it for this month friends, thanks for reading that far!

Hope you'll have an awesome June!!

The Early Access release is so close, I'm incredibly excited🚀🚀

Take care of yourself and others and see you in a month:D🧡

notes.title: Development Update #09
notes.content:
Hey friends, hope you're all doing well!:D🧡

It's time for another Paper Animal Adventure content update🚀



[h1]New Cookpot recipes🍽️[/h1]

This month I focused mainly on adding new content:) I felt like there weren't too many cookpot recipes, so I added a few more. There used to be 15 recipes, with 10 recipes for different colored Beans and 1 Coffee recipe. [b]I added 18 new base recipes[/b] (and a few other ones, but more on that later), which made cooking a bit more interesting:D

Here are a few of the new recipes/Items:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42505570/f48dca628567f37b43a0a4f90f187c277f98bd35.png[/img]

The [b]Breaded Cactus Fruit[/b] can be made with a Cactus Fruit which can be found in the Kaboom Dunes and some Protein Powder! There is also a Breaded Snail Shell, which can be made with the Snail Shell instead of the Cactus Fruit💪

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42505570/08c8a7c53be7e81311916317394c3f6cf98b843d.png[/img]

If you combine two fruits of the same type, you'll now get [b]Jam[/b] instead of Salad! These fruits include Tomapples, Velo Berries, Ferns, Cherrocks, Inukari Berries, Cactus Fruits, Strawberries and Bananas. But not Onions! 

If you use an Onion with another fruit...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42505570/765763dc830fc940415ceebbe2c2579dd86e48ce.png[/img]

...you'll get the [b]Fart Salad![/b] I know, legendary game design, thank you thank you

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42505570/4bfc78387cb8278f8d00e6e1511680ade632bfe2.png[/img]

Funky Leaf plus any fruit results in a [b]Leaf Burrito![/b] Eating this one allows you to charge Hype Units a lot faster💪

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42505570/88fe6afe547f5da545c131fa294d25879b89ee55.png[/img]

If you want to regenerate your Health Poins fully, cook an Onion with Honey to make [b]Medicine[/b]:D

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42505570/d965c5d69c1c1f317b5ff59f28f6f6da3472fd51.png[/img]

Another thing that wasn't possible before was making [b]Blue Beans.[/b] The game doesn't let you upgrade your Movement Speed normally, since it can make controlling a character pretty hard quickly, but if you want to try to do that anyway you can now make a Blue Bean with a Velo Berry and a Bean. Use at your own risk!



[h1]Super Cookpot🍳[/h1]

As soon as you collected the normal Cookpot, you can start searching for the [b]Super Cookpot.[/b] If you have the normal one, there's a 50% chance that an Enemy Camp will have a Super Cookpot, which you can steal to make even stronger Items🚀

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42505570/d3fa9d5f54c8ca32d6cb8f73f4bbbe1017ae85fc.png[/img]

The normal Cookpot only allows you to combine base Items together, which means as soon as you have a cooked Item you couldn't cook with it further.

The Super Cookpot doesn't have this restriction anymore! With it you can cook whatever you want together:D Because of that I introduced even more recipes, but these are Super Cookpot exclusive.



[h1]Super Cookpot Recipes✨[/h1]

The Super Cookpot "unlocks" more recipes, 14 Bean-related ones, and 11 other ones.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42505570/bae1f893482a6820a7a95d7e7ee03eae58d5f571.png[/img]

If you cook a basic Coffee with a colored Bean or with some other ingredients, you can get [b]colored Coffees[/b] now! The Coffee Item boosted a random stat by a high value, but with colored Coffees you can now target which stats you want to boost by a high value!:D

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42505570/8f0876500f0162235df7fc587dd7991451d67c34.png[/img]

If you tried a combination that didn't work and resulted in "Something", you can now use that "Something" and cook it with anything else to get the [b]Weird Shake.[/b] It's not insanely powerful, but it regenerates 2 Health Points, which makes it as strong as a Tomapple!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42505570/53fce341cf4e14d8761eca8638395a6dcd3a294f.png[/img]

Soup and a Sweetgum Pod results in the [b]Hedgehog Stew[/b], which increases Experience Points gain for the next few floors✨

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42505570/02c41880fce0b9e50ce80f0cd2817ba875cbfd8b.png[/img]

And Cake with any fruit results in a [b]Fruitcake.[/b] This doesn't regenerate all Health Points, but 18 is still quite a lot!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42505570/696cd2431a610eed95778266139937bef9e7d1ea.png[/img]

One of my favorite new Items is Pure Caffeine, which can be made with two Energy Drinks, or an Energy Drink with a Coffee.

This Items boosts your stats more and more with each one you eat, but there's a 20% chance of the character getting defeated when eating it. You should be very careful with it when only playing with one character, since eating it could result in a Game Over on a Camp floor😅



[h1]Cookpot Result Prediction🔮[/h1]

I also adjusted the Cooking menu a bit!:) If you already tried an Item combination at some point (also in other runs etc) the menu shows you what the result will be:D

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42505570/6b298f9af8b83b23dfe09d52f5ef0494e448dcbe.png[/img]



[h1]Crystal Forge💎[/h1]

Another bigger addition this month is the [b]Crystal Forge[/b], which allows you to modify Skills and their Attributes:D

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42505570/c4be02a20d27274784b97475f0dc04331dd09648.png[/img]

The Crystal Forge can also be found in Enemy Camps after you collected the Cookpot. If you enter a Dungeon Floor with Eclipsed weather and you already have the base Cookpot, the Crystal Forge will be guaranteed to be in one Enemy Camp. Otherwise it has a 25% chance to spawn:)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42505570/dc3eb486bb7697af29132b503c8ab3d0e62cf789.png[/img]

As soon as you collected it, you'll have a new station at the Camp available.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42505570/caba2dc44a567f6b6cc81b31ee7049798f3a87ff.png[/img]

Choose any Skill that you want to modify and then you'll get forwarded to this menu. For the modification process you'll have three tool slots available. The outcome depends on which tools are used, but also in which slots the tools are used!

There is also no randomness involved, meaning if you understood the system, you can make targeted modifications and get to that Skill that you want, with the Attributes you want to have with it.

These five tools are available:

[list]
[*] [b]Green Brush:[/b] Enhances Attributes
[*] [b]Red Saw:[/b] Weakens Attributes
[*] [b]Blue Wrench:[/b] Strengthens other Tools
[*] [b]Yellow Chisel:[/b] Changes Skill type
[*] [b]White Hammer:[/b] Adds attributes
[/list]

In the example picture above there's a Green Brush in the first slot and a Blue Wrench in the second slot. The third slot is empty. The Green Brush raises the level of the first Attribute by one, and the Blue Wrench strenghtens the Green Brush so that it raises the level by two.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42505570/48b5947473a27d185d065d0178cca01e5e28b7bc.png[/img]

Similar to the Cookpot the game saves which Tool combinations you already tried. If you want to use a Tool combination you already tried again, the game will tell you the outcoming Skill:D

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42505570/498193e7c8f3d2d2580b7630fbe8f915ebca8f50.png[/img]

Each time you modify a Skill it will get more expensive to modify it again.

But otherwise you can edit the Skills in any way you want:D You can modify a Nutbomb with Uncool 4 into a Pryoblast with Powerful 5:D



[h1]Icefruit🧊[/h1]

Since there is now also a Frappé recipe, the game needed some kind of ice Item. So I added the [b]Icefruit[/b]!:D

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42505570/f7aa7429c86b95df08876d0fd5563eb905715859.png[/img]

When the weather is Hail, an Icefruit Plant will appear, which will give you three Icefruits when you bump into it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42505570/19b5158d39de1110100454e1c7f8b07164cf2de3.png[/img]



[h1]Thanks for reading🧡[/h1]

That's it for this month friends, thank you for reading so far!

Super hyped to see what you all think about the new content:)

Be kind to yourself and others and see you in May!!:D🧡

notes.title: Development Update #08
notes.content:
Hey friends, hope you're all doing well!:D🧡

It's the last Friday of the month again, which means it's time for a Paper Animal Adventure content update💪



[h1]Thock⏰[/h1]

The Gear Shrine Depths were still missing a third enemy type and here it comes: The Thock enemy!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42505570/4e5123abdb7403d3c36f86d8cf09ff18a15a89e5.png[/img]

It's a big creature with a big clock face, armed with clock hands, a giant pendulum and a winding key on the top of its head.

It casts a few defensive buff on itself and has a bunch of HP - so it's quite tanky.

The Thock enemy can also summon two clock hands that surround it at different speeds. If you plan to tackle this enemy at melee range it's important to time your attacks, so that you don't get hit by the clock hands!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42505570/24602cde9cce57a0c178e9755591182db212eaec.png[/img]

It also uses a giant pendulum to attack at a distance. This pendulum attack can happen relatively fast and covers a big range, so it's best to always keep some room next to you to evade.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42505570/6c0f7d700aa8579ee70e53fc0ce2e68376fea358.png[/img]

It summons a big pendulum straight upwards and then it falls down with a big bell sound. Better take care!



[h1]Throne Room🪑[/h1]

I already showed the first phase of the final boss, but the throne itself was still a work-in-progress. I also managed to finish its design this month and I think it looks quite cool haha

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42505570/4a43f3da4a938f7942dc92e057b80def0270d112.png[/img]

The different clock hands at the back of it rotate in different speeds and patterns. Also the colors of the gem stones in the big ring resemble each area of the game!:D



[h1]More C-Skins✨[/h1]

I also finally got around to add the last few C-Skins. Here is a picture of some of the new ones:D

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42505570/2fd9a0eab7e180e2b08530e5bb5e4eb38094f9a7.png[/img]

From the left to the right here's Peep, Shelp, Kwak, Axel, Gobble and Nana:D



[h1]Gear Shrine Depths Entrance🚪[/h1]

When you enter the Gear Shrine now with all 7 other areas cleared, you can enter the North area. From here you can enter the final dungeon: The Gear Shrine Depths.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42505570/01da5ca0190e462dd5a898a8b079d217e9390c42.png[/img]

I always liked a big stairway guiding you deeper and deeper as an entrance for the final part of a game!



[h1]Gear Shrine Depths World Map🗺️[/h1]

As soon as you used the Gear Shrine Depths entrance you'll enter the World Map again, but this time only with the last area present.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42505570/a02f6bb9fb690f7a26653dd17ab45eeadb903ec0.png[/img]

Here you can also plan your path how you want💪

I also had to create all the small dioramas for the last area here again. These are all small things that do add up time-wise😅

Oh I also don't know if I mentioned it, but you can access the Gear Shrine Depths from each Gear Shrine, which means you could explore it directly after the Flat Flat Plains, or you can strengthen your team by going to Toy Box Tangle or Vector Space and then enter the last area with a stronger team - the choice is up to you!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42505570/7c427d88674fb413747d8b49846988411617f747.png[/img]



[h1]Outro🎥[/h1]

When you defeated the final boss a small outro sequence will play, which is very similar to the intro sequence style-wise. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42505570/2d919820a338ad450d3e37941c4428bee79d02c1.png[/img]

Like the intro, the outro also features a small story that is supported by an voice actor. If you don't want to watch the outro every time, you can also skip it to get directly to the run results💪

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42505570/d78a0e9758b373564d51e8182ea27fb9a253ee7e.png[/img]

The fantastic outro pixel art is done by the amazing Polyducks! Go pay them a visit:D



[h1]Thanks for reading🧡[/h1]

That's it for this month friends, thanks for reading so far!:)

Be kind to yourself and others and see you in April!🧡
